Alpha Centauri A.description: Primary of the Alpha Centauri system; a Sun-like star and the anchor of human space.

Alpha Centauri B.description: Orange companion to Alpha Centauri A; its industrial worlds orbit under a dimmer, redder sky.

Alpha Centauri C.description: The red dwarf Proxima; it dominates Proxima's night sky though it lies far from the A–B pair.

Regulus A.description: Fast-rotating blue subgiant at the heart of the Regulus system; Tycho's fierce daylight comes from this star.

Delta Pavonis.description: Quiet G-type subgiant; La Bella Vista orbits under warm, steady light.

61 Virginis.description: Sun-like star hosting Irasia's heavy industry and trade lanes.

61 Ursae Majoris.description: Stable main-sequence star anchoring Tokirev's cold industrial orbit.

18 Scorpii.description: Near-Solar analogue; Fennet grew under its calm temperate light.

Tau Ceti.description: Quiet G dwarf; Fortuna's finance districts orbit a dimmer, steadier sun.

61 Cygni A.description: Orange dwarf of the 61 Cygni binary; New Carthage trades under its ruddy light.

Epsilon Eridani.description: Young K dwarf with elevated particle wind; Horizon's vast cities orbit here.

Wolf 359.description: Dim flare star; Titania IX rides the turbulent skies of its gas-giant primary nearby.

Kepler-16 A.description: Primary of the Kepler-16 circumbinary; Pelagos sees two suns from its sky.
